intro_q: You recently attended a professional skills workshop and would like to thank the organizer and provide feedback. Write an email to the workshop organizer.
bullet2_q: Describe what you found most valuable.

sample.opening:
Dear Mr. Taylor,
I hope you are well.
sample.bullet1: I truly appreciate that you organized such a well-structured and engaging workshop. I was truly impressed by how many valuable insights were provided in such a short period of time.
sample.bullet2: I find the interactive group discussions to be especially valuable. They allowed participants to exchange practical ideas, which made the learning experience much more meaningful.
sample.bullet3: I would like to offer one small suggestion for future workshops. It would be helpful if more time were allocated for Q&A sessions at the end so that participants could fully understand the key concepts.
sample.closing:
Thank you in advance for your response. 
Best regards,
Li-Yi Chen
sample.bullet1_variety:
1: I (sincerely/truly) appreciate that you…
2: Passive voice (… was impressed by…)
sample.bullet2_variety:
1: I find (positive adj.)
2: Relative clause (…, which …)
sample.bullet3_variety:
1: I would like to (suggest/offer)…
2: Non-fronted subordinate clause (….if…) + purpose clause (…so that…)
